methods.name: Natural History Quiz
methods.note: Answer the quiz in the Varrock Museum basement for 1,000 Hunter XP, level 9, with no requirements. It gives 1,000 Slayer XP as well.

methods.name: Bird house runs
methods.note: Four houses on Fossil Island every 50 minutes, about 80 seconds a run. Build the best tier your Crafting allows (5 to 90); XP is after the August 2026 cut.

methods.name: Feldip weasels
methods.note: Track them in the Feldip Hunter area with a noose wand, rings of pursuit and staminas, about 270 an hour. Only for the few levels after the quiz.

methods.name: Red crabs
methods.note: Crab traps on The Pandemonium baited with fish offcuts; a catch never fails. Pandemonium only has to reach the island, and the traps need 10 Construction.

methods.name: Sapphire glacialis
methods.note: Net butterflies in the Rellekka Hunter area, about 840 an hour at 34 XP. From 35 you can catch them barehanded, and snowy knights fly there too.

methods.name: Falconry
methods.note: Piscatoris falconry area, 500 coins a falcon. Spotted kebbits, then dark at 57 and dashing at 69; since August 2026 you can move while the falcon flies.

methods.name: Drift net fishing
methods.note: Chase shoals into drift nets under Fossil Island for Hunter and Fishing XP, about 104 nets an hour. Bring breathing gear or the Medallion of the Deep.

methods.name: Blue crabs
methods.note: Crab traps on the north and east coasts of the Great Conch, baited with fish offcuts. Troubled Tortugans only has to be started, up to reaching the island.

methods.name: Razor-backed kebbits
methods.note: Piscatoris tracking with a noose wand, rings of pursuit and staminas, about 285 an hour at 348.5 XP. Fletch the spikes into bolts as you go.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon with a Kruk monkey greegree: ride a stunted demonic gorilla and bait the deadfall with a banana. One click every 25 to 30 seconds.

methods.name: Goat hunting
methods.note: Wyrmscraig: prod goats into the spiked pit with the free cattleprod, then loot the pit for most of the XP. About 15% of goats get away at 60.

methods.name: Red chinchompas
methods.note: Box traps in the Tlati Rainforest north-east of Tal Teklan; Eagles' Peak only has to reach box traps. Much faster from 80 with five traps, and profitable.

methods.name: Black salamanders
methods.note: Bone Yard in level 20 Wilderness, with one more net trap than elsewhere. Drop the salamanders as you go and teleport away if attacked.

methods.name: Hunters' Rumours
methods.note: Expert rumours from the Hunter Guild, with an XP block list and quetzal or fairy ring travel. Master rumours from 91 also need At First Light.

methods.name: Rainbow crabs
methods.note: Five crab traps on The Crown Jewel baited with fine fish offcuts; crush the crabs into stackable paste. The rate needs steady clicking and the island has no bank.

methods.name: Herbiboar
methods.note: Track the herbiboar round Fossil Island's Mushroom Forest with staminas, about 60 an hour. The herbs suit an ironman; bring magic secateurs and a herb sack.

methods.name: Stymphikes
methods.note: Vampyrium: bait a stymphike tree with letvek, hide in the bush and spear the bird. About three clicks every 45 seconds; each bait uses 1 to 3 letvek.

unverified: Natural History Quiz: 1,000 Hunter XP (and 1,000 Slayer XP) once, level 9 at 969; no hourly rate, so never dealt

Bird house runs: the table's XP a house (112 regular to 1,200 redwood) is the Ultimate Ironman guide's older figures cut by the official percentages of 19 August 2026, tier by tier; the effective rate assumes 80 seconds a run (45 an hour), the guide 73 to 90 seconds, the Ultimate Ironman guide 105 with a mounted digsite pendant and 145 with pendants; Crafting 5 is the regular house, the others need 15, 25, 35, 45, 50, 60, 75 and 90; an ironman also needs 25 Construction to make clockworks; runs never count towards Hunter's hours
Feldip weasels: the guide's 13,000 is 271 an hour at 48 XP, inside the tracking page's 270-300 an hour with rings of pursuit and staminas

Sapphire glacialis: 28,500 at 25 is one sentence both the main and ironman guides carry; the page has no catch chart and nothing rates the levels above 25 or the snowy knights from 35, so it is flat; the method that needs no quest from 25 to 42

Red crabs: the crab page's 30,000 (2 traps), 45,000 (3) and 55,000 (5) fit one crab cycle of 25.6 ticks and a lap of 7 ticks a trap, which puts 4 traps (60 to 79) at 55,000 as well; that band is the model's, no page rates 4 traps; Pandemonium only has to reach the island

Blue crabs: the middles of the crab page's 70,000-75,000 (3 traps), 85,000-95,000 (4) and 105,000-110,000 (5); one crab cycle of about 34 ticks and a lap of 7.6 ticks a trap rebuild them within 7%; the 5-trap figures of both crabs were added by an anonymous editor in April 2026; Troubled Tortugans only has to be started (its own start needs 51 Slayer and 48 Construction among others)

Falconry: the lower of 85% of each 'up to' and the lower figure (59,500 spotted, 68,000 dark, 80,800 dashing); each lower figure is about 990 attempts an hour at the kebbit's own level with Mod Ash's catch chances; since 19 August 2026 the player can move while the falcon flies and keep hunting with a full inventory, which the guide's figures predate, so they may now be low; a talk page note of August 2025 also calls them inaccurate

Drift net fishing: XP a shoal from the page's table; its prose says 72 Hunter XP at level 50 where the table says 62.5, and only the table matches the shoal page at 70 (101.5); the rate is 85% of the guide's 'up to 1,200-1,250' shoals (1,041, 104 nets), inside the page's 80 to 110 nets an hour; Wise Old Man's main table is above every band; breathing gear (Recipe for Disaster's Pirate Pete started, or the Medallion of the Deep, which works there since 20 May 2026) cannot go in req

Razor-backed kebbits: 285 an hour (the tracking page's 270-300 with rings of pursuit, staminas and quick banking, written 19 September 2026), 99,300; 85% of the guide's 'up to 130,000' is 110,500, 11% higher; without staminas the guide says up to 100,000

Maniacal monkeys: the guide's table is 85-86% of one click every 25 seconds at Mod Ash's catch chance (41% at 60 to 89% at 99) at every row, so it stands; the monkey page's 60,000 at 60 to 120,000 at 99 is the 25 to 27.5 second cycle; a Kruk monkey greegree is needed and cannot go in req

Goat hunting: one model (778 attempts an hour, the page's and Jagex's 80 row; about 15% failing at 60 as Jagex wrote, none by 80) rebuilds Jagex's 'just under 80k' at 60 and the page's 140,000 to 160,000 at 80 to 99 within 3%; the fall in failures between 60 and 80 is assumed, Jagex only gave 60; the page's 90,000 at 60 ignores the failures; Telekinetic Grab is a little faster and gives 10 XP a goat instead of 20

Red chinchompas: the guide's no-tick column is its own model (traps x Mod Ash's catch chance, anchored at 155,000 at 99) and the money making guide's 450-500 an hour at 80 (with a horn of plenty) agrees; with tick manipulation the guide gives 85,000 to 220,000, not carried; Feldip without Children of the Sun is about 58,000 to 89,000; Eagles' Peak only has to reach box traps

Black salamanders: middles of the guide's ranges at 67 and 73, 85% of its 'up to 140,000' at 79 and 'as high as 150,000' with six traps at 80, flat after 80 where no page rates them; the same catch chances at the guide's implied 115 attempts a trap an hour would give about 167,000 at 90 and 183,000 at 99; level 20 Wilderness, which req cannot say; net traps stack since 7 October 2026, after the guide's figures

Hunters' Rumours: 91 and 99 are 85% of 24 rumours an hour on the strategy page's best block list, rebuilt from the completion formula and the drop rates with the outfit (219,100 at 91, 229,700 at 99; the page says up to 235,000 at 99); 72 is the Ultimate Ironman guide's 'over 150,000', under the guide's 160,000 for a full outfit and block list; 72 to 90 is one band because nothing rates the levels between; novice and adept rumours (46, 57) have no rates; master rumours also need At First Light

Rainbow crabs: the guide's 122,000 (4 traps) and 155,000 (5) and the money making guide's 740 an hour 'with good focus' agree; now active, as that guide rates its intensity high; the crab page calls the loop low intensity, so a relaxed player gets less than the rate shown

Herbiboar: 60 an hour (money making guide), inside the herbiboar page's 59 to 66 with staminas; the main guide's table is 66 an hour; XP a catch is Mod Ash's formula plus 2.56 inspections of 50 XP; the Ironman Guide's 115,000-130,000 and the Ultimate Ironman guide's 120,000-150,000 bracket the bands

Stymphikes: 85% of the page's theoretical 83 an hour (143,175), flat, because XP a bird does not depend on level; one player measured about 140,000 at 86; the page's own table rises with level and is marked citation needed; letvek: 1 to 3 a bait, caught with box traps at 76 in Vampyrium (box traps need Eagles' Peak), dropped by venators and the Maggot King, or bought

Aerial fishing is in fishing.json; Hunter training says 25,000-80,000 Hunter XP an hour, and the 19 August 2026 changes (a 4x4 quick catch, fish from the inventory, larger pools) are newer than any rate on the wiki

Deadfall kebbits and pyre foxes (23 to 57): since 19 August 2026 two traps, catches start after 8 ticks and wild and prickly kebbits catch far more often, with XP cut by 20 to 27%; Jagex says about 60% more XP an hour (four times for wild kebbits) but no page rates them yet, and two catch charts are marked out of date; not carried

Not included: desert devils (13, about 18,500), ruby harvests with copper longtails (15, up to 20,000), swamp lizards (29, 20,000-45,000, Priest in Peril) and embertailed jerboas (39, 50,000 with Eagles' Peak and Children of the Sun), all short stretches the quiz, sapphire glacialis, red crabs and falconry cover; red salamanders (59, 80,000-105,000), never above razor-backed kebbits or black salamanders; orange salamanders (47; 40,000-50,000 at Uzer; at the Necropolis with Beneath Cursed Sands started and 62 Agility, 90,000-100,000 at 60 and about 145,000 at 80, above black salamanders for an account with that quest but not Children of the Sun); moonlight moths (75, upwards of 100,000) and sunlight and moonlight antelopes (72, 91, up to 135,000), under rumours with the same Children of the Sun; black chinchompas (73, 145,000 to 225,000 solo, only with tick manipulation in the Wilderness, about 94,500-110,000 without by the money making guide); letvek box trapping (76, about 145,000 with 3-tick manipulation); chompy birds (30 XP each since August 2026)
